rows.ARS:
Medium pink Shrub.
Exhibition name: Kölner Flora ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 2003).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2014.
rows.Bloom: Pink, apricot highlights. Strong, anise, myrrh, rose, sweet fragrance. 45 to 50 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Rounded buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Glossy, medium green foliage. 5 leaflets.

Height: up to 4¼' (up to 130cm). Width: 2' to 32" (60 to 80cm).
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 27,924 on 25 Apr 2017 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 14/756,367 on 2 Sep 2015
`KORmahensi` is a seedling selection which resulted from the controlled pollination of Rosa hybrida `AUSham` (U.S. Plant Pat. No. 11,421), the seed parent, and an unnamed breeding line developed and owned by the same inventor, the pollen parent, during the summer of 2003.

fragrance: Strong, anise, myrrh, rose, sweet fragrance.
